rules.title: Santa Ana Rent Stabilization Maximum Increase
rules.citation: Santa Ana Rent Stabilization and Just Cause Eviction Ordinance
rules.quote: Your landlord can only raise your rent by a certain amount each year. The increase cannot be more than 3% of your current rent or 80% of the Consumer Price Index (CPI) change, whichever is less.
rules.summary: Landlords may only increase rent by a maximum of 3% or 80% of the CPI change, whichever is less, each year.
rules.key_value: 3% or 80% of CPI, whichever is less

rules.title: Santa Ana Just Cause Eviction Requirement
rules.citation: Santa Ana Rent Stabilization and Just Cause Eviction Ordinance
rules.quote: Your landlord must have a valid reason to evict you. This could be for not paying rent, breaking the lease, or if the landlord wants to move into the property themselves.
rules.summary: Landlords must have a valid just cause reason to evict tenants, such as non-payment of rent, lease violations, or owner move-in.

rules.title: Santa Ana Relocation Assistance for No-Fault Evictions
rules.citation: Santa Ana Rent Stabilization and Just Cause Eviction Ordinance
rules.quote: If your landlord evicts you for certain reasons, they might have to help pay for your moving costs.
rules.summary: Landlords must provide relocation assistance to tenants evicted for certain no-fault reasons.

rules.title: Santa Ana Registration Fee Pass-Through Cap
rules.citation: Santa Ana Rent Stabilization and Just Cause Eviction Ordinance
rules.quote: If a landlord charges a tenant a pass-through fee greater than $50, the landlord shall reimburse the tenant for the registration fee pass-through overpayment.
rules.summary: Landlords may charge tenants a pass-through fee for registration costs but cannot charge more than $50 per unit.
rules.coverage_text: The pass-through fee is charged by rental unit, not by the number of tenants in a rental unit.
rules.penalty: the landlord shall reimburse the tenant for the registration fee pass-through overpayment
